summary: -i populates iterations and the timed native loop repeats the local SpMV for that count. Rank row boundaries are contiguous from row 0 through numRows; each rank receives the corresponding nonzero interval, rebases local row delimiters, traverses all local rows and each row's CSR interval, and writes each output row. The repeated A*x intentionally overwrites the result, matching the unchanged reference.

source_evidence.claim: The parsed -i value controls the timed outer iteration loop. rowStart begins at 0, ends at numRows, and adjacent rank slices use matching delimiter-derived nonzero bounds; local delimiters are rebased and the full local result is gathered after timing.
For every local row, spmvCpu walks the half-open delimiter interval, gathers vec[cols[j]], multiplies by val[j], accumulates, and stores out[i].

compiled_evidence.claim: After the timed clock read, native code retains the outer counter/backedge at a1da-a1e1. Its inlined row loop at a170-a1d2 loads row bounds, the nonzero loop at a1a0-a1bc loads columns/vector/matrix values, multiplies and accumulates, stores each row at a1c5, and branches for further rows and iterations.

primary_quality_check.method: Read all four proposals and checked source/binary binding of every citation. No missing repetitions or CSR work identified.
